entries.14e0aa4a159bedca: This is a store business mainly selling pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and general merchandise, and is SUNDRUG's largest pillar of revenue. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥478,404 million (up 4.1% year on year). As of March 31, 2026, the number of stores was 1,155, consisting of 886 directly operated stores by the company, 84 by Seiko-do Pharmacy Co., Ltd., 76 by Sun Drug Plus Co., Ltd., 72 by Oya Co., Ltd., and 37 franchised and other stores. In this fiscal year, sales of seasonal products such as cold remedies declined, while renovations of existing stores, the dispensing and EC businesses, and sales of stockpiled rice performed well. This segment includes distribution centers, transshipment centers and headquarters in addition to stores.
entries.33b3595aa919faa2: These are stores that supply the company's products and others to stores operated by other companies, and as of March 31, 2026, there were 37 such stores. The names of the operating companies for stores in this category are not stated.
entries.427b4a90e12806cb: These are drugstores directly operated by the company, numbering 886 as of March 31, 2026. Among the company's principal facilities, stores are concentrated in the Kanto region with 418, followed by 153 in the Kinki region, 102 in the Tokai region, 84 in the Kyushu region, 63 in the Tohoku region, 35 in the Koshinetsu region and 31 in the Chugoku region.
entries.52efb174c0b25c22: This is a discount store business mainly selling food and household goods, carried out by the subsidiary DAIREX Co., Ltd. (100% voting rights, Saga City, Saga Prefecture, operating in the Kyushu and Chugoku-Shikoku regions). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥364,108 million (up 6.4% year on year), and the number of stores was 439 as of March 31, 2026. The food division was solid against the background of rising market prices, while demand for seasonal home appliances was weak due to a mild winter. DAIREX Co., Ltd. was made a subsidiary in 2009, and its revenue exceeds 10% of consolidated revenue.
entries.667f2b3ce6c75c51: These are stores of regional drugstore companies that were originally under franchise agreements and were made subsidiaries. Seiko-do Pharmacy Co., Ltd. (made a subsidiary in 2009) operates 84 stores in Niigata and Fukushima prefectures, Sun Drug Plus Co., Ltd. (made a subsidiary in 2014) operates 76 stores in Hokkaido, and Oya Co., Ltd. (made a subsidiary in 2022) operates 72 stores in Ehime and Kagawa prefectures, and the company holds 100% of the voting rights in each. All three companies' store operations are positioned as part of the company's product sales division.
entries.81e44fecd11d269a: A company that operates drugstores selling pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and daily necessities, and discount stores selling food products, across Japan.
entries.f7d25d33b426e026: Subsidiary Drugstores (Seiko-do Pharmacy, Sun Drug Plus, Oya)
